sn52.9:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca anuruddho āyasmā ca sārīputto vesāliyaṃ viharanti ambapālivane.
sn52.9:1.2: atha kho āyasmā sārīputto sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sārīputto āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca
sn52.9:2.1: vippasannāni kho te āvuso anuruddha indriyāni parisuddho mukhavaṇṇo pariyodāto.
sn52.9:2.2: katamenāyasmā anuruddho vihārena etarahi bahulaṃ viharatīti.
sn52.9:2.3: catūsu khvāhaṃ āvuso satipaṭṭhānesu sūpaṭṭhitacitto etarahi bahulaṃ viharāmi.
sn52.9:2.5: idhāhaṃ āvuso kāye kāyānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.9:2.8: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn52.9:2.9: imesu khvāhaṃ āvuso catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu sūpaṭṭhitacitto etarahi bahulaṃ viharāmi.
sn52.9:2.10: yo so āvuso bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaññojano sammadaññā vimutto so imesu catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu sūpaṭṭhitacitto bahulaṃ viharatīti.
sn52.9:3.1: lābhā no āvuso suladdhaṃ no āvuso
sn52.9:3.2: ye mayaṃ āyasmato anuruddhassa sammukhāva assumha āsabhivācaṃ bhāsamānassāti.
